cases.name: nested numeric arrays preserve duplicates
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_scalar_arrays | WHERE id == "values" | EVAL picked = NESTED(SUM(items.price)) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: ordinary multivalue arithmetic remains null per child
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_scalar_arrays | WHERE id == "values" | EVAL picked = NESTED(SUM(items.price * items.quantity)) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: explicit per-object multivalue sum
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_scalar_arrays | WHERE id == "values" | EVAL picked = NESTED(SUM(MV_SUM(items.price) * items.quantity)) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: reduced field remains associated with its object
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_scalar_arrays | WHERE id == "values" | EVAL picked = NESTED_ANY(MV_MAX(items.price) == 3 AND items.quantity == 2) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: reduced fields cannot match across objects
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_scalar_arrays | WHERE id == "values" | EVAL picked = NESTED_ANY(MV_MAX(items.price) == 7 AND items.quantity == 2) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: scalarized nested keyword and key arrays
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_scalar_arrays | WHERE id == "values" | EVAL picked = NESTED(LAST(MV_MIN(items.sku), MV_MAX(items.rank))) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: raw multivalued selection remains rejected
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_scalar_arrays | WHERE id == "values" | EVAL picked = NESTED(LAST(items.sku, items.rank)) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: explicit reduction of Boolean arrays
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_scalar_arrays | WHERE id == "values" | EVAL picked = NESTED_ANY(MV_MAX(items.active)) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: raw multivalued Boolean predicate remains rejected
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_scalar_arrays | WHERE id == "values" | EVAL picked = NESTED_ANY(items.active) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: empty scalar arrays contribute no values
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_scalar_arrays | WHERE id == "empty_arrays" | EVAL picked = NESTED(SUM(items.price)) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: empty scalar arrays do not remove their object
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_scalar_arrays | WHERE id == "empty_arrays" | EVAL picked = NESTED_ANY(items.price IS NULL) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: nested double arrays
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_scalar_arrays | WHERE id == "values" | EVAL picked = NESTED(SUM(items.score)) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: nested integer ordering arrays
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_scalar_arrays | WHERE id == "values" | EVAL picked = NESTED(LAST(MV_MIN(items.sku), MV_MAX(items.seq))) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: all empty scalar arrays sum to null
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_scalar_arrays | WHERE id == "all_empty" | EVAL picked = NESTED(SUM(items.price)) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: all empty scalar arrays still have a child object
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_scalar_arrays | WHERE id == "all_empty" | EVAL picked = NESTED_ANY(items.price IS NULL) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: no child objects remain distinct from empty fields
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_scalar_arrays | WHERE id == "no_items" | EVAL picked = NESTED_ANY(items.price IS NULL) | KEEP id, picked
